Valentine.specialties: Early-game purchases: American Standardbred (Palomino Dapple), Hungarian Halfbred (Dapple Dark Grey), Dutch Warmblood (Chocolate Roan). Bonus horses (SUE/POB) are redeemed here.

Strawberry.specialties: Andalusian (Dark Bay). Chapter 3+: Dutch Warmblood (Seal Brown) and Thoroughbred (Brindle).

Scarlett Meadows.specialties: Ardennes (Bay Roan), Dutch Warmblood (Sooty Buckskin). Chapter 4+: Missouri Fox Trotter (Amber Champagne).

Van Horn.specialties: Chapter 6+: Andalusian (Rose Grey), Ardennes (Strawberry Roan), Appaloosa (Leopard).

Saint Denis.specialties: Black Arabian (Ch.4+), Gold Turkoman (Ch.4+), Nokota - top tier

Blackwater.specialties: Rose Grey Bay Arabian, Missouri Fox Trotter, Turkoman - BEST horses

Tumbleweed.specialties: Epilogue purchases: Tennessee Walker (Flaxen Roan), American Standardbred (Silver Tail Buckskin), American Paint (Grey Overo), Appaloosa (Brown Leopard), Turkoman (Silver).

temperamentControversy.officialMechanics: According to game data miners and the wiki, ALL horses share the same base 'courage' stat. Bonding level 2-4 each add +1 courage, reducing bucking chance.
temperamentControversy.communityExperience: Despite official data, players consistently report breed differences. Andalusians, Mustangs, and Turkomans are widely praised as calm. Arabians and Tennessee Walkers are frequently called skittish.
possibleExplanations: Hidden per-horse RNG that varies each spawn
Undocumented breed modifiers not found in data mining
Confirmation bias - players expect certain breeds to behave certain ways
Horse size affecting player perception of stability
Different animation timing making some horses 'feel' calmer
temperamentControversy.recommendation: Focus on bonding level (biggest confirmed factor). Community reports can guide breed selection, but individual results may vary.

handlingTypes.Heavy: Slowest turning radius. Large horses (Shire, Ardennes, Hungarian Halfbred). Can feel clunky in forests.
handlingTypes.Standard: Moderate turning. Most common handling type. Good all-around.
handlingTypes.Race: Quick turning. Racing horses (Thoroughbred, Nokota). Responsive but fragile.
handlingTypes.Elite: Fastest turning. Premium horses (Arabians only). Best maneuverability.
